final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, qc_count, 1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts) SELECT status, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
